# L2Cache — Privacy-First macOS Clipboard Manager & Developer Intelligence

> L2Cache is a high-performance, 100% local, privacy-focused macOS clipboard manager built with native Swift and SQLite. It provides complete clipboard history, shell command preservation, on-device AI integration, and built-in developer utilities with zero telemetry and zero cloud sync.

L2Cache is designed specifically for software engineers, power users, and privacy-conscious professionals on macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 14.0+ Sonoma & macOS 15+ Sequoia). It costs $4.99 as a one-time purchase with lifetime updates and no subscriptions.

## Core Pages & Features

- [Homepage](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en): Overview of L2Cache features, native macOS performance, and App Store availability.
- [Clipboard History for Mac](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/clipboard-history-mac): 100% on-device SQLite FTS5 full-text search across unlimited clipboard items (text, images, code, files, colors).
- [Developer Intelligence & AI](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/intelligence): Local Apple Intelligence and on-device AI assistant integration, tracking AI coding session history (Claude Code, Codex, Aider) and token analytics without cloud exposure.
- [Mac Command & Shell History](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/mac-command-history): Dedicated terminal command capture with syntax highlighting, search, and one-click re-execution.
- [Custom Actions & Workflows](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/custom-actions): Automated clipboard transformations using regex, bash scripts, and custom formatting pipelines.
- [Developer Clipboard Features](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/developer-clipboard): Specialized developer workflows, code snippet management, and fast keyboard navigation.
- [Performance Benchmarks](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/benchmark): Independent memory and CPU benchmarks showing under 15MB RAM footprint and 0.0% idle CPU usage.
- [Privacy & Security Report](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/clipboard-privacy-report): Detailed privacy architecture showing zero network requests, zero telemetry, and automatic exclusion of password managers (1Password, Bitwarden, Apple Keychain).
- [Changelog](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/changelog): Release history, version notes, and continuous improvements.
- [Support](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/support): Documentation, FAQ, shortcuts guide, and customer support.

## Developer Web Utilities

L2Cache offers free web versions of its built-in developer tools at https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/tools:

- [Developer Tools Hub](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/tools): Complete collection of web-based developer utilities.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/json-formatter-mac): Instant client-side JSON formatting, validation, minification, and tree navigation.
- [JWT Decoder](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/jwt-decoder-mac): Offline JSON Web Token decoder and inspector (header, payload, signature validation, expiration checking).
- [Regex Clipboard Tester](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/regex-clipboard-mac): Interactive regex matcher and tester for clipboard snippets.
- [Screenshot OCR Tool](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/screenshot-ocr-mac): Local optical character recognition to extract text from images and screenshots.
- [SQL Test Data Generator](https://l2cache.amvo.store/en/sql-test-data-generator): Mock data generator producing valid SQL INSERT statements for testing.

## Technical Specifications

- **Platform**: macOS 14.0 Sonoma, macOS 15.0+ Sequoia (Universal Binary: Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3/M4 & Intel x86_64)
- **Engine**: 100% Native Swift, SwiftUI, AppKit, SQLite 3 (FTS5 + WAL mode)
- **Privacy Model**: 100% local on-device database, zero network connectivity, zero analytics/telemetry
- **RAM Usage**: ~12MB to 15MB typical idle footprint
- **Pricing**: $4.99 USD one-time purchase via Apple Mac App Store (includes Family Sharing & lifetime updates)
- **App Store Link**: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/l2cache-clipboard-manager/id6740089851
